newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Textile group Kwong Hing set for Hong Kong IPO.
newsitem.headline: Textile group Kwong Hing set for Hong Kong IPO.

text.p: Textile company Kwong Hing International Holdings Ltd is planning to launch an initial public offering to fund its expansion, market sources said on Tuesday.
The Hong Kong-based company is still awaiting listing approval from the stock exchange and the size and timing of the deal were not yet known, the sources said.
They expect Kwong Hing to kick off the IPO later this month. "Proceeds will be used to buy new machinery, to buy a factory in China and to expand production capacity," one source said.

Kwong Hing makes and dyes textiles. It had turnover of HK$350 million for the year ended March 31, 1996 compared with HK$330 million a year earlier and profit of HK$27 million compared with HK$17 million the previous year, sources said.
Standard Chartered Asia is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, they added. Standard Chartered officials were not immediately available for comment.
